item.title: Three minors arrested after 11-year-old girl threatened with replica gun in Uithoorn
item.description: Three minors were arrested after an incident in Uithoorn on Sunday in which an 11-year-old girl was repeatedly struck and threatened with what later proved to be a fake gun.

item.title: Rabobank, ING, and ABN Amro seek European alternatives to U.S. technology
item.description: The three largest banks in the Netherlands, ABN Amro, ING, and Rabobank, have spoken about their plans to reduce their reliance on American tech companies.

item.title: Life sentence for man who stalked, murdered ex-girlfriend was justified: Supreme Court
item.description: Courts may impose a life sentence on defendants convicted of severe violent crimes even if they require psychiatric care, the Dutch Supreme Court ruled on Tuesday.

item.title: Ye’s Back: Kanye West to perform in the Netherlands for the first time since 2013
item.description: Musical artist Ye, formerly known as Kanye West, will perform his first show in Europe in 12 years at the GelreDome in Arnhem on June 6, it was announced on Tuesday.

item.title: Nieuw-Vennep man convicted for misleading parents about umbilical cord stem cells
item.description: A man from Nieuw-Vennep, aged 44, has been sentenced to a six-month conditionally suspended jail term and 240 hours of community service for scamming the parents of infants.

item.title: Home goods chains Kwantum and Leen Bakker bought by German investment firm
item.description: Orlando Capital V, an investment firm, intends to take over home goods chains Kwantum and Leen Bakker. Homefashion Group, the parent company, says an agreement has been signed.

item.title: Amsterdam-Zuidoost tests tunnel lighting to make streets safer for women
item.description: The municipality of Amsterdam-Zuidoost is testing new lighting designs in several underpasses to improve safety for women, city officials reported.

item.title: Video: Teen posing as police officer used 90-year-old woman’s walker to steal her safe
item.description: A teenager posing as a police officer robbed a 90-year-old woman of all her jewelry at her home in Breda.

item.title: Student room rent hikes levelling off; Increased only 1.6% in Q4
item.description: Student room rents barely increased in the last quarter of 2025, and in Amsterdam and Haarlem, they remained unchanged, Kamernet reported.

item.title: Heineken to cut up to 6,000 jobs in two years; Booked €1.9 billion profit in 2025
